steps.caption: Running median: keep the smaller half in a max-heap and the bigger half in a min-heap. The median sits at their tops.
Add 5: push to lower, move lower's max to upper, rebalance so lower has the extra one. Median = top of lower = 5.
Add 15: push to lower, move lower's max to upper, rebalance so lower has the extra one. Median = average of both tops = 10.0.
Add 1: push to lower, move lower's max to upper, rebalance so lower has the extra one. Median = top of lower = 5.
Add 3: push to lower, move lower's max to upper, rebalance so lower has the extra one. Median = average of both tops = 4.0.
Add 8: push to lower, move lower's max to upper, rebalance so lower has the extra one. Median = top of lower = 5.
